Lemma
1. Lemma 5.13\group ch05-viscosity-solutions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0107, han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0108 ↗ hanlin:ch05-def-5-4 ↗ hanlin:ch05-thm-5-8 There are $\varepsilon _0>0$, $\mu \in (0,1)$, and $M>1$, depending only on $n,\lambda ,\Lambda $, such that if $u\in \Splus (\lambda ,\Lambda ,f)$ in $B_{2\sqrt n}$, $f\in C(B_{2\sqrt n})$, and \[ u\geq 0,\qquad \inf _{Q_3}u\leq 1,\qquad \| f\| _{L^n(B_{2\sqrt n})}\leq \varepsilon _0, \] then $|\{ u\leq M\} \cap Q_1|>\mu $.

Proof

\sketch Add a concave barrier and apply Theorem 1 to its convex envelope. The contact set is contained in a fixed sublevel set of $u$.

□
